summary: Zoom AI Companion provides meeting summaries, smart recordings, and chat summaries. It is on by default for paid accounts but can be turned off by the account admin in settings. Individual users can disable it for their own meetings if the admin allows it.

steps.path: Account admin: Admin → Account Management → Account Settings → AI Companion → toggle off
Individual host: Settings → AI Companion → toggle off for your meetings
Per-meeting: when scheduling → Meeting Options → uncheck AI Companion

collateral: disabling AI Companion removes meeting summaries and smart recording chapters
admins can lock the setting so individuals cannot re-enable it
whyTheyDidIt: Zoom is competing with Teams on AI features and uses meeting transcripts as training data.

sources.label: Zoom Support — Getting started with AI Companion

alternatives.name: Jitsi Meet
alternatives.why: open-source video conferencing, no AI features, self-hostable
